title: Ferriage
summary: FER'RIAGE, noun [See Ferry.] The price or fare to be paid at a ferry; the compensation established or paid for conveyance over a river or lake in a boat.

inlines.v: FER'RIAGE, noun [See Ferry.] The price or fare to be paid at a ferry; the compensation established or paid for conveyance over a river or lake in a boat.
